agent_data_note: Use mounted SF110 + EvoSuite at `dataset_candidate/sf110-evosuite/`. Run DynaMOSA with paper budgets (180s search / 600s assertion timeout). Implement observability treatments (injected getters and/or recursive assertions) without changing coverage goals or the mutant set. Follow the paper protocol: 100 CC>3 classes × 4 configs × 30 seeds.
benchmark_rules: Subjects: 100 non-trivial SF110 classes with cyclomatic complexity > 3 (same subset as prior EvoSuite studies / paper).
Baseline: EvoSuite DynaMOSA with search budget 180s and assertion timeout 600s.
Treatments: (1) injected public getters for private/protected fields; (2) recursive assertions on composed objects (depth n=3); (3) both combined.
Injected code must be ignored for coverage goals and mutation analysis so mutant sets match the baseline.
Primary metric: mutation score; also report statement/branch/suite coverage and A12 vs baseline across 30 seeds per class/config.
Shared mount is read-only. Copy CUTs and write generated tests, logs, and metrics under `project/` or `results/`.
If the exact 100-class list is missing, reconstruct CC>3 filtering or obtain figshare replication https://figshare.com/s/46bfa8872f668fafdf66.
non_goals: Using only trivial accessor-only classes as the primary evaluation
Changing coverage goals or mutant operators between treatments
Reporting coverage-only results without mutation score
